% ADDED figure (2026-11-17): crossing one external leg, after PS p. 155 (the pair of diagrams below eq. (5.67)); generated by qft-C/tools/l21/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\tikzset{
  fline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.56 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5.5pt, width=4.5pt]}}}},
  sline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, dash pattern=on 3.5pt off 2.2pt},
  blob/.style={draw, line width=0.8pt, fill=figB!12},
}
\tikzset{
  pline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, decorate, decoration={snake, amplitude=1.6pt, segment length=5.2pt}},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  % (a) incoming particle
  \begin{scope}
    \draw[fdl] (-1.5,1.2)--(0,0); \draw[fdl] (-1.7,0.2)--(0,0); \draw[fdl] (-1.5,-1.0)--(0,0);
    \node[circle, blob, minimum size=1.15cm] (B) at (0,0) {};
    \coordinate (x) at (2.3,0);
    \draw[fdl] (B) to[bend left=28] (x); \draw[fdl] (B)--(x); \draw[fdl] (B) to[bend right=28] (x);
    \node[fdlab] at (1.25,0.62) {$q_1$}; \node[fdlab] at (1.25,0.17) {$q_2$}; \node[fdlab] at (1.25,-0.62) {$q_3$};
    \node[fdv] at (x) {};
    \draw[fline, figR] (3.0,-1.7)--(x);
    \draw[fdmom] (3.25,-1.35)--(2.9,-0.5);
    \node[fdlab, right, figR] at (3.0,-1.75) {$\phi$, incoming};
    \node[fdlab, right] at (3.2,-0.85) {$p$};
    \node[fdlab] at (1.0,2.0) {(a) $\mathcal M(\phi(p) + \cdots \to \cdots)$};
    \node[fdlab] at (1.0,-2.6) {into the vertex: $q_1 + q_2 + q_3 + p = 0$};
  \end{scope}
  % (b) outgoing antiparticle
  \begin{scope}[shift={(7.6,0)}]
    \draw[fdl] (-1.5,1.2)--(0,0); \draw[fdl] (-1.7,0.2)--(0,0); \draw[fdl] (-1.5,-1.0)--(0,0);
    \node[circle, blob, minimum size=1.15cm] (B) at (0,0) {};
    \coordinate (x) at (2.3,0);
    \draw[fdl] (B) to[bend left=28] (x); \draw[fdl] (B)--(x); \draw[fdl] (B) to[bend right=28] (x);
    \node[fdlab] at (1.25,0.62) {$q_1$}; \node[fdlab] at (1.25,0.17) {$q_2$}; \node[fdlab] at (1.25,-0.62) {$q_3$};
    \node[fdv] at (x) {};
    \draw[fline, figR] (3.0,1.7)--(x);
    \draw[fdmom] (2.9,0.5)--(3.25,1.35);
    \node[fdlab, right, figR] at (3.0,1.75) {$\bar\phi$, outgoing};
    \node[fdlab, right] at (3.2,0.85) {$k = -p$};
    \node[fdlab] at (1.0,2.0) {(b) $\mathcal M(\cdots \to \cdots + \bar\phi(k))$};
    \node[fdlab] at (1.0,-2.6) {$q_1 + q_2 + q_3 - k = 0$};
    \draw[->, gray] (5.3,-0.9)--(5.3,0.9); \node[font=\scriptsize, gray, right] at (5.3,0) {time};
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
